pairs.question: Vīsne locum mūtēmus?
pairs.derivation: Illustrative example in the section on Answers (the affirmative). Stripped the enclosing single quotes and the trailing English gloss ('Shall we change the place?' 'Certainly.'). One speaker asks, another affirms; real interrogative (-ne) genuinely answered.

pairs.question: Estīsne vōs lēgatī?
pairs.derivation: Illustrative example in the section on Answers (affirmative by repetition of the verb). Stripped enclosing single quotes and trailing English gloss ('Are you envoys?' 'Yes.'). Real interrogative (-ne) answered by the repeated verb.

pairs.question: Jam ea praeteriit?
pairs.derivation: Illustrative example in the section on Answers (the negative). Stripped enclosing single quotes and trailing English gloss ('Has it passed?' 'No.'). Real yes/no question answered negatively.

pairs.question: Estne frāter intus?
pairs.derivation: Illustrative example in the section on Answers (negative by repeating the verb with a negative). Stripped enclosing single quotes and trailing English gloss ('Is your brother within?' 'No.'). Real interrogative (-ne) answered by the negated verb.
